description: This file provides database access functions for managing device documents in a MongoDB collection, including collection setup, CRUD operations, and data serialization.

methods.name: MongoClient _get_client()
methods.description: Returns a singleton MongoClient instance, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: Collection get_collection()
methods.description: Returns the Mongo collection, creating it if needed, and ensuring validator and indexes exist.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _normalize_dates(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts last_ping_time from ISO string to datetime object for storage.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _serialize_device(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Serializes MongoDB document to JSON-friendly dict, converting ObjectId and datetime fields.

methods.name: ObjectId _parse_object_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Converts a string to an ObjectId, raising ValueError if invalid.

methods.name: str insert_device(device: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Inserts a device document into the collection, returning its inserted ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] find_devices( filter_query: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, sort: Optional[List[Tuple[str, int]]] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, skip: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Finds documents matching a filter with optional sorting and pagination, returning serialized results.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] update_device( filter_query: Dict[str, Any], update_doc: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Updates multiple documents matching a filter, returns counts of matched and modified documents.

methods.name: Dict[str,int] delete_device(filter_query: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Deletes documents matching a filter, returning the count of deleted documents.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its ObjectId string, returning serialized data or None.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_by_name(name: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a device by its unique name, returning serialized data or None.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] replace_one_by_id(id_str: str, new_doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Replaces a device document identified by ObjectId, returning the updated document.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] replace_one_by_name(name: str, new_doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Replaces a device document identified by name, returning the updated document.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_one_by_id(id_str: str, partial: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Partially updates a device identified by ObjectId, returning the updated document.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_one_by_name(name: str, partial: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Partially updates a device identified by name, returning the updated document.

methods.name: bool delete_one_by_id(id_str: str)
methods.description: Deletes a device by ObjectId, returning True if successful.

methods.name: bool delete_one_by_name(name: str)
methods.description: Deletes a device by name, returning True if successful.
